definitions.full: H2278. chabereth [ חֲבֶ֫רֶת ] noun feminine consort , i.e. wife חֲבֶרְתְּךָ וְהִיא Mal 2:14 (|| בְּרִיתֶ֑ךָ אֵשֶׁת ).

occurrences.englishText: Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because Yahweh has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously, though she is your companion, and the wife of your covenant.
